items.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
items.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Ninja’s first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once
items.summary: The Ninja Crispi Microwave stands out for its FusionCrisp technology, which combines the speed of a microwave with the crispy results you'd expect from an air fryer.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Northwood Space raises $375M Series C at a $2B valuation from a16z and DFJ growth
items.summary: Space infrastructure company Northwood Space on Monday said it had raised $375 million in a Series C round co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and DFJ Growth, valuing the company at $2 billion.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: A fresh wave of cyberattacks has hit Europe’s supermarket refrigerators, destroying food across countries
items.summary: This is the second wave of cyberattacks to hit supermarket refrigerators in a month, spoiling food and disrupting supplies.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker
